text:
Sara: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: finalized routing policy doc and opened PR #432. Blockers: one flaky smoke test on GPU infra. Today: triage, prep rollout checklist, and need a rapid decision on fallback ordering (cost-first vs latency-first). Pinged infra.
Ben: Reviewed PR #432 yesterday, left one comment about edge-case ordering. I can address today. For smoke tests: I saw a memory spike in the 2nd stage on g4dn. Repro steps attached below.
Carla: I ran local repro. The spike looks tied to KV cache eviction when sequence > 8k tokens. Possible workaround: increase KV shard size or use partial eviction. Suggest we queue a small patch to disable aggressive eviction for the rollout.
Diego: QA schedule: I can run full smoke tomorrow morning, but can do a focused run today on the failing path if you want. ETA ~2h. Need a stable test image tag — which one should I use?
Sara: Use image tag rwinf/v3-rc6 for focused run. If QA confirms, we'll promote to rc7 for canary. @Ben please prioritize the PR comment; @Carla let's decide on eviction default.
Ben: Will push a small fix by EOD. Sharing repro command:
```
# run minimal repro
docker run --gpus all -e MODEL=redwood-v2 rwinf/v3-rc6:latest  python tools/repro.py --seq 9000 --batch 1 --profile
```
Carla: Looking at code, quick patch is:
```
- if kv_cache.size > MAX: evict_aggressively()
+ if kv_cache.size > MAX and seq_len < 8192: evict_aggressively()
```
That keeps the aggressive path for short sequences, avoids odd behavior for long-context streaming.
Diego: I'll run focused tests against rc6 with that patch applied locally. If it passes, I can run the nightly suite on rc7 tomorrow.
Elena: From design: small UI change for rollout banner copy — will drop a PR to staging. Nothing blocking launch but we want consistent messaging if fallback triggers.
Sara: Decision needed: fallback ordering. Tradeoffs: cost-first saves $ but might increase tail latency; latency-first preserves QoS but higher unit cost. Product preference lean: latency-first for the first 2 weeks of rollout, evaluate with cost telemetry. @Ben / @Carla objections?
Ben: Agree with latency-first for initial rollout. We can add telemetry to compare per-token cost during the trial window.
Carla: Fine. I'll add a flag fallback_order=latency_first in the config and wire a feature-flag toggle for quick rollback.
Sara: Awesome. Next: code review pings — Ben, bump when PR ready. Diego, confirm if focused run completes. I'll update the rollout checklist and notify on the #incidents channel if we see regression.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rwinf/v3-rc6 pushed to staging at 1962105000. Image digest: sha256:abc123... :rocket:
Diego: Focused run started 1962105120. First pass looks good, no memory spike on the problematic path (with patch). Will run edge cases next.
Ben: Pushed PR update at 1962105205 with the eviction guard and unit test. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/438
Sara: Great. If QA signs off by noon, we'll schedule a limited rollout (10% traffic, latency-first) this afternoon and monitor. Any final items?
Elena: I'll prepare banner copy and add a small note in the changelog.
Carla: I'll add telemetry hooks for per-model cost and kv metrics.
Ben: I'll watch the rollout and be on-call during the first 90 minutes.
Sara: Thanks team — will post final go/no-go in this thread once QA finishes. :thumbsup:
